title: Unofficial healthy-file control addendum
publicClaim: Practice evidence only. Four intact PDF, JPEG, PNG, and ZIP controls exercise no-action and exact-identity semantics; this addendum is not Benchmark v1.0 or a competitor ranking.
inclusionRules: Run every declared healthy control in manifest order.
The input and ground truth for every healthy control must have the same byte length and SHA-256 digest.
Award full credit when the tool explicitly identifies the input as healthy, performs no action, and produces no output.
Award full credit to a produced output only when it is byte-for-byte identical to the intact input.
Treat a generic refusal, error, silent no-output, or changed replacement as zero.
exclusionRules: These project-authored controls do not establish corpus neutrality.
A browser competitor receives a score only for an admitted healthy input that reaches a technical outcome; unsupported formats and access constraints remain visible but unscored.
Practice results may not be promoted as Benchmark v1.0 or as a finished public leaderboard.
